entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A jungle plane hiding the city of gold Orazca, with rival factions racing for its secret.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The hidden city of gold that houses the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: A mysterious artifact housed in Orazca.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who poses as a pirate on the high seas.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker stranded on Ixalan with the loss of all his memories.

events.summary: Vraska poses as a pirate on the high seas while Jace is stranded on Ixalan without his memories.
events.quote: Vraska poses as a pirate on the high seas, while Jace Beleren is stranded on the plane with the loss of all his memories.

events.summary: The Sun Empire and River Heralds are met by the Legion of Dusk and the Brazen Coalition as all race for Orazca's secret.
events.quote: The dinosaur -riding warriors of the Sun Empire and the merfolk shamans of the rival River Heralds are met by the vampire conquistadores of the Legion of Dusk and the pirates of the Brazen Coalition .

relations.quote: For centuries, the untamed jungles of Ixalan have hidden a coveted secret: Orazca , the city of gold, which houses a mysterious artifact, the Immortal Sun .
